method: 27 visible statements per project, checked against exact declarations, persisted Story/event read APIs and independent Git/PR workline checks.
gateScope: High-risk intent, progress, plan, release, merge and dependency assertions; source-binding correctness is separate from semantic wording precision.
limitations: This is Agent source inspection, not human or Owner review. Model claims do not become verified facts.
Generic observed Story wording and fallback event-time provenance remain quality issues; no perfect semantic-accuracy claim is made.
Passing reference checks alone is not evidence that a product capability was run or verified.
